Amal: FYI noticed a mismatch between console UI and API permissions for Project 518 — UI shows edit button for Viewer users but backend save returns 403. @Sasha can you take a look? :thinking:
Sasha: ack. can you paste an example user + project id? any stack traces?
Amal: user tara@example.com, project 518. Repro steps:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/api/v1/projects/518/config -d '{"name":"test"}'
# response: 403 {"error":"permission denied","reason":"rbac: deny - missing console.edit"}
```
Jordan: grabbing audit logs...
Jordan: audit entry: `ts=2026-03-19T18:23:12Z user=tara@example.com action=project.update res=project:518 effect=deny reason="inheritance=false, required=console.edit"`
Sasha: hmm, policy change from last deploy added a shadow-deny when role inheritance flag is false. looks like the role matrix migration didn't set 'inherit_to_projects' for org-viewer role.
Amal: oh — that would explain UI mismatch. UI shows button because it reads local permissions cache which still had old mapping.
sec-oncall-bot: INCIDENT INC-9876 created (priority=P2) — added eng-security + oncall. https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-9876
Sasha: temp mitigation: toggle the UI to re-evaluate with server permissions until we fix. I'll push a quick policy-mapping patch to set inherit_to_projects=true for org-viewer.
Jordan: putting together migration script: `rbacdb update-roles --role org-viewer --set inherit_to_projects=true --dry-run` then apply. Will run in staging then prod. ETA 25m.
Amal: can you also attach KMS audit? we saw a few KMS unwrap errors earlier today; ensure keys didn't block audit writes.
Jordan: KMS logs show no decrypt failures for this user — not related. tags: kms:key-arn=arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd status=OK
Sasha: rolling patch to rbac-service config now. will follow up with postmortem doc + test cases to prevent future mismatch. @Amal can you own QA on a few viewers?
Amal: yes. I'll test with cohorts: viewer, org-viewer, editor. Will validate UI button hide/show matches API. :thumbsup: 
Sasha: after patch we'll run `rbacctl explain --user=tara@example.com --resource=project:518` and check output.
Jordan: confirmed dry-run migration output looks good. scheduling for rollout in 10m. will pause if any new denies surface.
Amal: thanks. please post final migration output + prod audit line in this thread.
Sasha: will do. closing loop once prod audit shows `effect=allow` for tara.
